response.sql: WITH equipment_averages AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg FROM equipment_averages), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, o.overall_avg FROM equipment_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE e.avg_humidity > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity FROM kept) SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_humidity, k.avg_humidity - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, ABS(k.avg_humidity - m.mean_humidity) AS distance_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE k.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.mean_humidity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY distance_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
